title: "Session 8 · Visualization"
subtitle: "Base graphics, ggplot2, and honest statistical communication"

## Learning goals

Choose a plot for a statistical question, read and construct layered ggplot2 code,
create a fast base R diagnostic, and export a figure at an explicit size.

## Materials

- [Slides](slides.qmd)
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd)
- Starter file: `starter/visualization-lab.qmd`

Either base graphics or ggplot2 may be used where both support the communication
goal. The lab asks for one figure in each style so that you can read both.
